name: Avalanche Bulletin
description: A public avalanche bulletin: the danger level with its name, danger by slope and height on a rose, the avalanche problems and the forecaster's note.

props.name: bulletin
props.description: Everything the bulletin shows, described below.

props.name: bulletin.region
props.description: The heading, such as a mountain range.

props.name: bulletin.areas
props.description: The places the bulletin covers, under the heading.

props.name: bulletin.issued
props.description: When the bulletin was written, already formatted.

props.name: bulletin.level
props.description: The danger level. It is shown large as a number on a tile in its colour, with its name (Low, Moderate, Considerable, High, Very high), its place on a five-step scale and a sentence on what it means.

props.name: bulletin.levels
props.description: Danger for each of eight aspects, from north clockwise, and three elevation bands, from lowest to highest. Drawn on the rose; pointing at or arrowing to a cell reads it out, and the whole grid is also given as a table to screen readers.

props.name: bulletin.bands
props.description: Names of the three elevation bands, from the centre of the rose to its rim.

props.name: bulletin.headline
props.description: One sentence on the main danger, under the level.

props.name: bulletin.tendency
props.description: A short note on how the danger will change.

props.name: bulletin.problems
props.type: { kind, title?, aspects, bands?, elevation, time, hours?, description }[]
props.description: The avalanche problems, as cards. kind is wind-slab, persistent-weak-layer, wet-snow, new-snow or gliding-snow and picks the drawing and default title. aspects and bands fill a small rose for where; hours ([from, to], 0 to 24) fills a small day dial for when.

props.name: bulletin.forecaster
props.type: { name: string; role?: string; avatar?: string; text: ReactNode }
props.description: The forecaster's note at the foot, signed.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the article. Other article props are passed through. Set --miyuki-avalanche-bulletin-gap to the surface colour if you place it on something other than the page background.
